notes.title: Version 1.10 has been updated

At night 3 March 2022(West Indonesia time, GMT+7), we have update new version of Dato of Srivijaya 1.1.

>New Map updated
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39072969/eeaa783ee56c767c87ac3715353823ec16b78456.jpg[/img]
>Fixed time speed
>Mini map can be shortcut to go another region
>Fixed recruiting all soliders

>Add new SFX in constructing and recruiting
>Add new system: constructing only 1 buildings and another building must wait.
>Add new system:Several buildings need support another buildings level
>Add siege system

notes.title: Dato of Srivijaya 1.05 version has been released!
notes.content:
After 2.5 months developing 1.05 (lot of problems happen since only one programmer working).,
Dato of Srivijaya 1.05 has been released!!

In this version, many new things like.
-> You can play Mataram (Javanese), Sunda(Sundanese), and Srivijaya (Malay)
_>Opening visual for Srivijaya
->New visual for town, village, and city depends on region
->Week time to Month time with moon image(but its not change builidng system time).
->Naval battle (for now only Srivijaya, Sunda, and Java can send naval expedition).
->New Achivements !
-> Trade routes Chinese and Indian. Locals will come soon  in 1.07 version


However many plans annonced before pending in 1.07 version.

1.07 will make 1-2 factions can playable and new system like vasal and diplomatic. When this version out?
Hope in early April 2021.

Thank you and enjoy playing Sunda and Mataram .
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39072969/7bf89d9e8feed027ad60c26c7b286b11e761ae4b.jpg[/img]
[b]Some advice[/b]
1.Sunda:Recommend and more easier to control compare Srivijaya, lack of mans in first time, and Mataram, problem of stability.
2.Srivijaya:Need to play to understanding basic of Dato of Srivijaya, but expansion of Srivijaya quite hard since facing Malay.
3.Mataram:Quite hard since stability become first problem before expansion.

notes.title: Dato of Srivijaya 1.00
notes.content:
Dato of Srivijaya 1.00 has released and you can play it, but this version still temporal . 

Why? Many things not yet add since our our project deadline very near and we need to make final report for this project. Also many ilustrator not yet finish their draw since
they have school and this is big project for them so this is first time 
So this is limited version (like early access) and don't worry, Dato of Srivijaya will have big update soon especially near Xmas! 

Some features has complate and not

>Conquer settlements in everywhere

>All kingdoms AI has added, but only several can sent military mission. Also their knowledge not so smart now. If you has play Pedalahusa Fall of Bali and Perang Laut  Maritime Warfare (our game before , but not in Steam), the system quite similiar.

>Time limited only to 700 AD
>Diplomatic features not complate (no vasal system yet)

>Battle System not perfect 
>No historical events
>International trading and diplomation not yet set

>Only Srivijaya now can have navy (and only playable faction in this version)

So enjoy Dato of Srivijaya 1.00 and give your feedback so new update will better than this version!
(Hope in update version, Sunda and Mataram can playable. Also historical events)

notes.title: Devlog II:Information of Sunda Kingdom
notes.content:
[b]Sunda Kingdom[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39072969/a0c085f8683318ee42884f4810db645c159d8154.jpg[/img]
[i]Some Sunda's city in Dato of Srivijaya[/i]
Special Unit: [b]Puragabaya [/b](Elite soliders based on princes from many kingdoms belongs to Sunda. )
Special Building: [b]Kabuyutan [/b](Sacred place. Boosting loyality to king and stability.)

Short infromation:

Sunda Kingdom is kingdom in West Java and successor of Tarumanegara kingdom after last Tarumanegara's king transfer his power to Tarusbawa, prince of Sunda in 669 CE(This is year Sunda will appers in game takeover Tarumanegara).

Sunda Kingdom focus in Pasundan land (Land of Sunda) and not pay attention to attack antoher kingdoms outside Java or to East Java. King of Sunda focus make his people happy, protecting nature by Kabuyutan, and protecting land from enemy invasion  King of Sunda rule many small kingdoms in Pasundan and Banten which sometimes can challange Sunda Kingdom.. 

Puragabaya is special infantry units selected from best princes or special peoples. They can beat easily enemy infantry units. 

Relation of Sunda with another kingdoms very depends. Sunda kingdom don't like to show off their power and unlike Srivijaya or Mataram, Sunda didn't have maritime expansion and focus in collecting wealth from ports in north coast Sunda kingdom from Banten to Cirebon. 

If stability of Sunda's shaken, Galuh kingdom will appers in east Sunda land and become challanger for Sunda or twin kingdom. It's depends for ruler of Sunda(and player if playing Sunda).

You can play Sunda kingdom  after player complating Srivijaya's campaign and decide fate either Sunda just kingdom or great empire in Southeast Asia.

Units in Sunda kingdom have Ancient Sundanese voice.

notes.title: Devlog I:Information of Srivijaya Empire
notes.content:
[h2][b]Srivijaya Empire/Kadatuan Srivijaya[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39072969/35fbb41f43654c5630c0ea9d7ad859f196631bc8.png[/img]
Special unit: Orang Laut (They only can recruit in around Strait of Mallaca, very powerful in sea and river fighting)

Special building: Sriksetra (Garden, increase production of resource and loyalty)
[b]
Short introduction:[/b]

Srivijaya's origin still unknown before Kedukan Bukit inscription in 683 CE and after Kedukan Bukit, expansion of Srivijaya's against many state in Sumatra and Java begin. 

System of Srivijaya is kadatuan or federation of [i]dato[/i]/lords. As long as dato pledge to maharaja or great dato, he can rule his area and this made Srivijaya  Empire can survive in long time.

Beside focusing in trade and expansionist, Srivijaya's ruler very concern in diplomatic relation around Asia from Caliphate in Damascus, Emperor in Xian, and Indian states beside improving quality of Buddhist Monk's study,

In Dato of Srivijaya, Srivijaya started in Palembang at 650 with small village, low army, and resource while another kingdoms like Malay in Jambi and Tarumanegara in Karawang enjoy global sea trade.  In first time, player must build Palembang and conquer several settlements (village) near Palembang either in upstream/[i]hulu[/i] or downstream/[i]hilir[/i] Musi rivers and another rivers before facing Malay kingdom, strong kingdom in Jambi...

Since there are no clue what is like flag of Srivijaya, we use junk sailing in white background as flag of Sriwijaya while red flag used in war.

Here our composer, Raden Agung, composing war theme of Srivijaya. 
[previewyoutube=_FnNzQt5yU8;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
